title: Restore publishing to a live storefront
ask: A storefront the game is live on is missing something it needs to publish — a preset, a pipeline step or a credential. Find which and restore it. Being live somewhere we cannot push to is worse than not being there: it reads as a channel and is not one.
first_action: Open #/pillar/sales, expand the storefront ladder, and read which requirement is marked missing.
